# Foot & Ankle Centre

Foot & Ankle Centre is a podiatry, chiropody, physiotherapy and foot and ankle surgery clinic group serving Chingford, Wanstead, Westcliff-on-Sea, London and Essex.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://www.footandanklecentre.co.uk/
- Book online: https://www.footandanklecentre.co.uk/booking
- Prices: https://www.footandanklecentre.co.uk/prices/
- Blog: https://www.footandanklecentre.co.uk/blog/

## Services

- Routine podiatry and chiropody care
- Foot pain assessment, plantar fasciitis care, orthotics and insoles
- Ultrasound guided injections and diagnostic injections
- Shockwave therapy, physiotherapy, myofascial release, triggerpoint therapy, dry needling and cupping therapy
- Ingrowing toenail treatment, verruca treatment, corn removal, hard skin removal, fungal nail care and long nail care
- Foot and ankle surgery, cosmetic foot surgery including bunion correction, hammertoe correction, webbed toe separation, scar-free toe shortening, flat foot correction and lumps and bumps removal

## Clinics

- Chingford: Stationhouse Medical Centre, 66 Station Road, London E4 7BA
- Wanstead: 11-13 Cambridge Park, Wanstead, London E11 2PU
- Westcliff-on-Sea: 51 Milton Road, Westcliff-on-Sea, Southend-on-Sea SS0 7JP
